about_the_game:
Race the mothership. Light the relays. Live the night.

The mothership is falling. With Sola in your visor, you’ve got one shot! Cross the dark to three relay sites, feed them plasma cores, and cut the descent. Scavenge BitCredits, fuel, oxygen, and ammo in abandoned sectors. Claim outposts to restock. Ride a hungry hoverbike, choose your fights with roaming Crawlers, and make every minute count.

How it plays

  • Hunt ruined zones for plasma cores, fuel, oxygen, and ammo.

  • Stabilize cores (they decay in-hand) and stash them in containers to recharge.

  • Traverse fast on your hoverbike, burn fuel, dodge patrols, and follow Sola’s bearings (no map hand-holding).

  • Deliver five powered cores to each distant relay before the global countdown hits zero.

Difficulty Modes

  • EASY - No descent timer. Explore and experiment at your pace.

  • HARD - Descent timer enabled. The clock is always ticking; fail if it hits zero.

Features

  • Tactical survival with health / oxygen / stamina management

  • Core loop: find → stabilize → deliver plasma cores to relays

  • Fast traversal on a fuel-hungry hoverbike

  • Claim outposts to restock ammo and spend BitCredits

  • Guidance from Sola 

  • Enemy pressure from roaming Crawlers + a relentless global timer (Hard Mode)

  • Sola: Dynamic Dialogue (optional, local-only) - toggle on at startup to let Sola answer questions and provide guidance. Off by default.

Content notes

Low-light environments, time pressure, and arachnid-like enemies.

Early Access

First version. In active development. Planned to receive regular updates based on feedback. Test it. Break it. Share your thoughts.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains non-graphic sci-fi violence. Players shoot alien creatures, and some areas include human corpses in space suits as environmental detail. It also features low-light settings and arachnid-like enemies that may unsettle some players. There is no sexual content, drug or alcohol use, self-harm, dismemberment, or realistic gore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / Ryzen 3 1200 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM (→ 12–16 GB if Sola LLM is enabled) GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / GTX 1650 / Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible
  • Additional Notes: For lower-end hardware, disable Sola: Dynamic Dialogue at startup for best performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores) or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM (→ 24 GB recommended if Sola LLM is enabled) GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible
  • Additional Notes: For lower-end hardware, disable Sola: Dynamic Dialogue at startup for best performance.

short_description: Planet Dwarvuk has been deemed unworthy by its own AI, which has summoned an ancient alien race to erase the world. Silence the signal before the destroyers arrive, or watch Dwarvuk fall.
